primary_question: Measure H0 to ~1% precision via a covariance-weighted Local Distance Network, addressing the Hubble tension.

named_outputs.variants: multiple analysis variants (anchor subsets, indicator subsets)
named_outputs.deliverables: publicly released software and data products (analysis scripts + tables)

design_constraints: method/anchor calibration uncertainties propagated through covariance
peculiar-velocity uncertainty propagated to magnitude space (5/ln10 * sigma_v / cz)
intra-group depth scatter included for SBF group calibrators
non_negotiable_steps: Define a linear GLS model with parameters {mu_host_i}, M_B, M_SBF, H0 (as a magnitude offset 5log10 H0)
Build full covariance with anchor errors, measurement errors, calibration nuisance, peculiar-velocity, depth scatter
Solve via weighted/generalized least squares (matrix form)
Run variants: all-anchors, single-anchor, single-primary, single-secondary
